title: The Boy With the Ball
mainIdea: Sharing your talents can help you build friendships and confidence.

pages.text: Hector moved to a new town and did not know any other children his age.

question.text: Who is the main character in the story?

pages.text: Hector wanted to make friends at his new school.
Hector felt nervous because he was new and did not know anyone in his class.

options: He did not know anyone at school

pages.text: At recess, Hector showed his classmates the ball tricks he had practiced all summer.

question.text: What did Hector do to help solve his problem?

pages.text: The students were impressed by Hector's tricks and wanted to be his friends.

options: Hector made new friends through his talent
Hector stopped playing with the ball

elements.correct: To make friends at his new school
He was new and did not know anyone
He showed his ball tricks during recess
His classmates admired him and became his friends
distractors: His classmates ignored his ball tricks
His classmates laughed and walked away
